name: Upper Body and Recomposition Program
description: Chest-priority hypertrophy program with complete lower-body training, direct abdominal work, posture control, and a swimming recovery day.

effort: Finish most working sets with 1-3 clean repetitions remaining.
Do not train every set to complete failure.
progression: Begin near the bottom of the repetition range.
Keep the load until every planned set reaches the top of the range.
Increase by the smallest practical amount.
Return to the bottom of the range after increasing the load.
Bodyweight increase: small backpack load or a controlled harder variation.
rules.postureCue: Ribs down. Abdomen braced. Glutes controlled. Keep the lower back neutral.
returnAfterBreak: Use 3 sets instead of 4 on primary exercises during the first week.
Use 2 sets instead of 3 on accessory exercises during the first week.
Use approximately 75-85% of previous working loads.
Restore full volume during week two only if recovery is normal.

days.name: Upper A — Chest and Back Strength

exercises.name: Paused Barbell Bench Press
formTips: Plant both feet and pin the shoulder blades to the bench.
Lower the bar to the lower chest with wrists stacked.
Pause motionless on the chest without relaxing.
Press while keeping the hips in contact with the bench.

exercises.name: Shoulder-Width Pull-Up
formTips: Begin from a controlled hang with the shoulders engaged.
Drive the elbows down toward the ribs.
Keep the legs quiet and avoid swinging.
Lower under control to full elbow extension.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Floor Press
formTips: Lie square on the floor with both feet planted.
Brace against rotation before lowering the dumbbell.
Touch the upper arm softly to the floor.
Press with the wrist stacked over the elbow.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
formTips: Keep the chest in contact with the incline bench.
Pull the elbows toward the hips without shrugging.
Pause briefly when the dumbbells reach the torso.
Lower until the shoulder blades move apart under control.

exercises.name: Lean-Away Dumbbell Lateral Raise
formTips: Hold a stable support and lean away as one rigid line.
Lead the raise with the elbow rather than the hand.
Stop near shoulder height without shrugging.
Lower the dumbbell slowly through the stretched position.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
formTips: Start with the hips and knees bent to about 90 degrees.
Curl the pelvis toward the ribs without kicking the legs.
Lift only until the tailbone clears the mat.
Lower slowly without letting the lower back arch.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Lift with Full Exhale
formTips: Set the hips and knees at 90 degrees with the feet supported.
Dig the heels down gently to tilt the pelvis back.
Exhale fully until the lower ribs settle.
Inhale quietly without losing the pelvic position.

days.name: Lower A — Legs and Core Control

exercises.name: Front Squat
formTips: Rest the bar across the front shoulders and keep the elbows high.
Brace before descending between the hips.
Track the knees in line with the toes.
Drive through the whole foot while keeping the torso tall.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
formTips: Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Reach the free leg back while keeping both hips square.
Lower the dumbbells close to the standing leg.
Drive the standing foot down to return without twisting.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
formTips: Place the entire working foot on the step.
Drive through the elevated leg instead of pushing off the floor.
Keep the working knee aligned with the toes.
Lower under control to the starting position.

exercises.name: Sliding Hamstring Curl
formTips: Lift the hips before sliding the heels away.
Keep the pelvis level throughout each curl.
Pull the heels back using the hamstrings.
Shorten the range if the lower back begins to arch.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
formTips: Set the balls of the feet on a stable edge.
Hold the dumbbell securely across the thighs.
Lower the heels into a controlled calf stretch.
Rise fully and pause at the top of each repetition.

exercises.name: Wall Tibialis Raise
formTips: Lean the upper back against the wall with the feet forward.
Keep both heels planted throughout the set.
Lift the toes toward the shins as high as possible.
Lower the forefeet slowly without shifting the hips.

exercises.name: Bird Dog with Pause
formTips: Stack the hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips.
Brace before reaching the opposite arm and leg long.
Pause without letting the pelvis rotate.
Return slowly while keeping the spine neutral.

days.name: Upper B — Back, Arms and Posture

exercises.name: Weighted Chin-Up
formTips: Secure the added load so it cannot swing.
Start from a controlled hang with the palms facing you.
Pull the chest toward the bar by driving the elbows down.
Lower to full extension without dropping into the shoulders.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
formTips: Hinge until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Brace with the bar resting motionless before each repetition.
Pull the bar toward the lower chest without raising the torso.
Return the bar to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
formTips: Place the hands just inside shoulder width.
Keep a straight line from the head through the heels.
Lower with the elbows tracking close to the ribs.
Press the floor away without letting the hips sag.

exercises.name: Prone Y-Raise
exercises.equipment: Bench or floor / Light dumbbells optional
formTips: Lie face down and reach the arms into a wide Y shape.
Point the thumbs upward and keep the neck long.
Lift from the shoulder blades without shrugging.
Use a small controlled range instead of swinging.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
formTips: Keep the upper back supported and arms hanging behind the torso.
Curl without moving the upper arms forward.
Keep the wrists straight as the dumbbells rise.
Lower fully and slowly into the biceps stretch.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
formTips: Hold the dumbbell securely with both hands overhead.
Keep the elbows pointed forward and close to the head.
Lower behind the head without flaring the ribs.
Straighten the elbows without moving the upper arms.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
formTips: Stand tall with the dumbbell held at one side.
Resist leaning toward or away from the load.
Walk with short controlled steps and level shoulders.
Turn carefully without letting the weight swing.

exercises.name: Easy Indoor Swimming
formTips: Swim at an easy pace that allows relaxed breathing.
Use smooth strokes rather than chasing speed.
Keep the neck relaxed and exhale steadily underwater.
Pause or change stroke if the shoulders become uncomfortable.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge March
formTips: Lift into a bridge with the ribs down and glutes engaged.
Raise one foot only after the pelvis is steady.
Keep both hip bones level while alternating legs.
Use a smaller march if the lower back takes over.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
formTips: Press the lower back gently into the mat.
Exhale as the opposite arm and leg extend.
Reach only as far as the ribs and pelvis stay controlled.
Return slowly before alternating sides.

exercises.name: Side-Plank Reach-Through
formTips: Stack the supporting elbow directly under the shoulder.
Lift the hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Rotate through the upper torso as the free arm reaches under.
Return to a stable side plank without dropping the hips.

exercises.name: Couch Hip-Flexor Stretch
formTips: Pad the back knee and place the rear foot securely.
Tuck the pelvis gently before moving upright.
Squeeze the rear-leg glute to focus the stretch at the hip.
Avoid gaining range by arching the lower back.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Lift with Full Exhale
formTips: Set the hips and knees at 90 degrees with the feet supported.
Dig the heels down gently to tilt the pelvis back.
Exhale fully until the lower ribs settle.
Inhale quietly without losing the pelvic position.

days.name: Upper C — Chest, Shoulders and Abs

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Press
formTips: Set the bench to a low or moderate incline.
Plant the feet and draw the shoulder blades back and down.
Lower the bar toward the upper chest with stacked wrists.
Press without lifting the hips or shrugging the shoulders.

exercises.name: Deficit Push-Up
exercises.equipment: Stable push-up handles or non-rolling supports
formTips: Confirm both supports are stable before starting.
Keep the body rigid from the head through the heels.
Lower the chest between the hands through a comfortable range.
Press evenly through both hands without flaring the ribs.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
formTips: Take an overhand grip and begin from a controlled hang.
Set the shoulders before driving the elbows down.
Bring the upper chest toward the bar without kicking.
Lower under control to full elbow extension.

exercises.name: Elbows-Out Dumbbell Row
formTips: Hinge at the hips and hold the torso steady.
Row the dumbbells toward the upper ribs with elbows out.
Pause as the shoulder blades draw together.
Lower slowly without rounding the lower back.

exercises.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Press
formTips: Stand with both feet planted and brace before pressing.
Start the dumbbell at shoulder height with the wrist stacked.
Press overhead without leaning away from the weight.
Finish with the arm beside the ear and ribs controlled.

exercises.name: Rear-Delt Dumbbell Row
formTips: Hinge forward and keep the spine neutral.
Use a light load that allows the elbows to travel wide.
Pull toward the upper ribs without shrugging.
Lower slowly until the rear shoulders are lengthened.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
formTips: Use a secure grip and begin from a still hang.
Curl the pelvis upward before lifting the legs.
Raise only as high as the torso stays controlled.
Lower slowly without swinging into the next repetition.

days.name: Lower B — Legs, Carries and Abs

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
formTips: Set a wide stance with the toes turned out comfortably.
Brace and pull the slack from the bar before lifting.
Drive the knees in line with the toes as you push the floor away.
Stand tall without leaning back at lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
formTips: Step back far enough to keep the front foot planted.
Descend with the front knee tracking over the toes.
Keep the torso controlled and hips square.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing.

exercises.name: Heels-Elevated Goblet Squat
formTips: Place both heels evenly on a stable support.
Hold the dumbbell close to the chest and brace.
Let the knees travel forward in line with the toes.
Descend as deep as possible without losing pelvic control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
formTips: Place the upper back securely against the bench edge.
Keep the working foot planted beneath the knee.
Hold the pelvis level as the hips rise.
Finish by squeezing the glute without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
formTips: Use stable support if balance limits the movement.
Lower the heels into a full controlled stretch.
Rise onto the balls of the feet without rolling the ankles.
Pause briefly at the top before lowering.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
formTips: Stand tall with equal loads held securely at both sides.
Keep the ribs stacked over the pelvis while walking.
Take short steady steps without swaying.
Keep the shoulders level and weights clear of the legs.

exercises.name: Kneeling Barbell Rollout
exercises.equipment: Barbell with securely rolling plates / Mat
formTips: Confirm the plates roll securely before kneeling at the bar.
Tuck the pelvis slightly and brace before rolling forward.
Reach only as far as the lower back stays neutral.
Pull the bar back by tightening the abs and lats.

exercises.name: Light Walking
formTips: Keep the pace easy enough to support recovery.
Walk tall with relaxed shoulders and a natural stride.
Choose a flat comfortable route when the legs feel fatigued.
Skip the walk if rest would better support recovery.

standaloneWorkouts.name: Full Body Reset
standaloneWorkouts.description: A moderate full-body session for returning after missing several training days.
standaloneWorkouts.recommendedUse: Use after missing approximately two or more scheduled training days. Do not use it to add another hard session immediately after a completed full-body workout.
rules: Use approximately 70-80% of normal working loads.
Finish every set with 2-3 clean repetitions remaining.
Do not repeat exercises already trained heavily the previous day.
Return to the regular weekly program after recovery.

exercises.name: Front Squat
formTips: Keep the elbows high.
Brace before descending.
Stay balanced over the whole foot.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
formTips: Hinge at the hips.
Keep the lats tight and knees soft.
Stand tall without over-arching.

exercises.name: Paused Barbell Bench Press
formTips: Stay braced during the pause.
Touch the chest softly.
Keep feet and hips planted.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
formTips: Start with the shoulders down.
Pull the elbows toward the ribs.
Control the lowering without swinging.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
formTips: Keep the chest on the bench.
Pull the elbows toward the hips.
Keep the shoulders away from the ears.

exercises.name: Standing One-Arm Dumbbell Overhead Press
formTips: Brace before every press.
Stay centered over both feet.
Keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
formTips: Keep the elbows close.
Maintain a neutral grip.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
formTips: Keep the elbows near the head.
Keep the upper arms still.
Keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
formTips: Use a full range of motion.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without bouncing.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
formTips: Curl the pelvis toward the ribs.
Keep the shoulders active.
Reset any swing between repetitions.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
formTips: Keep the ribs stacked over the pelvis.
Walk tall without swaying.
Maintain a strong full-hand grip.
